prompt: On a 1541, after I send a DOS command on the command channel, how do I read the error/status channel in BASIC, and what does the channel return after a command that succeeded? Give the exact response.
assertions: Open the command channel with OPEN 15,8,15 and read it with INPUT#15 (into four variables: code, message, track, sector)
A successful command returns error code 00
The success message text is OK
The track and sector fields are 00,00 on success
